title: India is the only market now that Japanese investors are keen about; Suzuki-backed Next Bharat Ventures announces a new $200 mn fund in India
description: For Japanese investors, Japan’s market is shrinking. China market is no longer an option as it is becoming a closed market now. European markets are getting stale. American market is already too competitive because of its local policies and local organisations. The Southeast Asian market is already capped out. African market is very fast paced, it’s not ready yet. Now the only growth market which Japanese investors look into is India. India is the only priority market for Japanese investors now.
